text:
Bitcoin maintained support above the $64,000 threshold on Saturday morning, holding steady after an active week of recovery from sub-$58,000 ranges. Stable spot ETF inflows continue to provide an underlying cushion for risk assets, offsetting minor headwinds from late-week options expiry dynamics and broader market focus on the upcoming Humphrey-Hawkins testimony.

Traditional markets closed the week with modest gains, with the S&P 500 rising 0.42% to 7,575.39 and the Nasdaq Composite ticking up 0.29% to 26,281.61, supported by bank and technology shares following Nasdaq's record-breaking SK Hynix IPO. Meanwhile, the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield settled slightly higher at 4.56%, while the Dollar Index (DXY) remained flat at 100.97. Stable real yields and flat dollar performance are providing a constructive consolidation window for digital assets, keeping immediate macro-driven sell-offs in check.
